spans.s:
गौड गौड, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गुड), prepared
from sugar or molasses; (ई), f. rum or spirit distilled
from molasses; one of the Rāgiṇīs, the wife of the
Rāga Megha; a style of poetry, the bold and spirited
[]
style; the Bengal dialect; (अम्), n. sweetmeats;
(अस्), m., scil. देश, or (अम्), n., scil. राष्ट्र,
the sugar country; N. of a country, ‘the district of
Gaur,’ the central part of Bengal, extending from
Vaṅga to the borders of Orissa, (the ruins of its
capital called by the same name are still extensive);
(आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of this country; (अस्), m.,
N. of a Rāga; N. of a lexicographer.
—गौड-देश,
अस्, m. the country Gauḍa.
—गौड-पाद, अस्, m.,
N. of a commentator on several Upaniṣads and on
the Sāṅkhya-kārikā.
—गौड-पुर, अम्, n., N. of
a town.
—गौड-भृत्य-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a
town.
—गौडाभिनन्द or गौडाभिनन्दन
(˚ड-अभ्˚), अस्, m., N. of a poet.

गौडक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people living to the
east of Madhya-deśa.
—गौडक-मृग, अस्, m. a
wild horse; [cf. गौर-खर.]

गौडिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to sugar or molasses,
fit for the preparation of sugar, prepared with sugar
or molasses; (अम्), n. rum.
गौडीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Gauḍa or Bengal.
